21st_magic_component_builder.rationale: `execute` posts `message`, `searchQuery`, `context`, and `fileContent` read from `absolutePathToCurrentFile` to `/api/create-ui-variation`, then returns code selected through `CallbackServer.promptUser` as `content[].text`. The file read means private host file contents can influence/appear in the returned result, but the exact behavior of `getContentOfFile`, `twentyFirstClient`, and `CallbackServer` is not shown, so SECRET is kept as undetermined. The returned component snippet comes from remote 21st.dev/callback data (`response.data.data1` etc. and `componentData.code`), so it is treated as UNTRUSTED.

21st_magic_component_inspiration.rationale: `execute` sends `message` and `searchQuery` to `/api/fetch-ui` through `twentyFirstClient` and returns remote `data.text` as `content[].text`. The description says this fetches matching components/previews from 21st.dev, so the returned snippet/data is treated as externally sourced UNTRUSTED content; the code does not show the server-side data source, so this is undetermined.

21st_magic_component_refiner.rationale: `execute` reads host file content via `getContentOfFile(absolutePathToRefiningFile)`, sends it as `fileContent` to `/api/refine-ui`, and returns remote `data.text` as `content[].text`. Because the returned redesign may include or derive from the private local file, SECRET is kept; exact remote behavior and `getContentOfFile` are not shown, so this is undetermined. The returned redesigned component/instructions are remote service output and are treated as UNTRUSTED.

logo_search.rationale: `execute` queries the external SVGL API, takes `logo.route` from that response, fetches SVG text from it with `fetchSVGContent`, converts it, and returns it inside JSON in `content[].text`. The logo title/URL/SVG/code are external registry/web content and are therefore UNTRUSTED. The tool also writes a local test-results file, but that is not attacker-readable by itself and no schema argument directly names an attacker-readable destination.
